visibleTestCases.title: Heir Transfer Survival and Reclaim
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin catch ets:delete(resilient_cache), {ok, Guardian} = ets_heir_handshake:start_guardian(), Creator = spawn(fun() -> Tab = ets_heir_handshake:create_resilient_table(resilient_cache, Guardian), ets:insert(Tab, {k1, <<"persistent_value">>}), timer:sleep(10), exit(intentional_crash) end), timer:sleep(50), Info = ets:info(resilient_cache), OwnerIsGuardian = (proplists:get_value(owner, Info) =:= Guardian), ok = ets_heir_handshake:reclaim_table(Guardian, resilient_cache), [{k1, Val}] = ets:lookup(resilient_cache, k1), Guardian ! stop, {OwnerIsGuardian, Val} end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Verifies table ownership moves to guardian on crash and data is fully reclaimed.

visibleTestCases.title: Verify Heir Survival Demo
visibleTestCases.explanation: Demonstrates end-to-end crash survival with ETS lookup validation.
